Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a tracked part, part A, for this test on an earlier day, date A, with 4 in its bin at a cost of $10.00, so the Inventory Value report saved a figure for it on date A.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839450 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839450-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 4 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save. Do this one day before you run the test, then run the test the next day, so the report has saved a figure for that earlier date.
  • Use a new part number that no part and no Part Library entry has yet, and that does not contain part A's number.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
